comments.author: @NiceTriGuy
comments.text: We have a place near the base of the cliff on Loyalist 5 min away.  What is a real mystery is how consistent the water level has been over centuries. Even in dry seasons.  Lake Ontario goes up and down several feet year to year but good old LOTM has been perfectly balanced by nature.  Beautiful spot, both restaurants are great as well.

comments.author: @eckosters
comments.text: Cool. Im a geologist and I happened to have been there several times, last in 2022. Most of your video is shot from the site of the restaurant (where we had a family wedding). My family always asks me what the origin of the lake is, but since I’m from Nova Scotia, I had never really taken the time to look into it. Of course I realized that a perched lake on/in limestone is an oddity. It being lined with glacial flour (sediment), makes sense as a reason for it not draining. Thanks!
